description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.001 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Any public web page -> clean LLM-ready Markdown + RAG chunks in one call: main content via Mozilla Readability (no nav/ads/footers), absolute links, title/description/language/canonical/published+modified dates/JSON-LD types, word + token estimates, sha256 content hash for change detection, and heading-aware chunks (configurable size + overlap, each with its heading path). Plain HTTP, robots.txt respected, Markdown/plain text passed through. Flags pages that likely need JavaScript. When to use: Use page-rag to feed a web page into an LLM or a vector store. Use page-meta or page-check for SEO/meta tags and HTTP status only. page-markdown is the older, simpler converter; page-rag is recommended.

chunk_tokens.description: chunk size in tokens (0 = no chunks, default 800, max 4000)

main_only.description: main content only via Readability (default true)
